blocks.html: Pin a flat map or sketch onto the live terrain, then stretch and rotate it to line up with the ground so the whole team reads the same picture.

slides.title: Open the Rubber Sheet tool
slides.html: Select the Rubber Sheet icon to open its toolbar. The toolbar options are Import, Sort, Export and Search.

slides.title: Import the 2D image
slides.html: Pan and zoom the map to where the imagery belongs. Select the + icon, pick the image file, then select OK. The image lands on the map and is listed under Rubber Sheets in Overlay Manager.

slides.title: Open the radial menu
slides.html: Tap the imported image to open its radial menu. From here you can adjust the fit, set Opacity, add a Label, or open Details.

slides.title: Fit it to the ground
slides.html:
Select Edit to size, rotate and place the image.

  • Drag a corner to resize.
  • Drag an edge midpoint to change size and rotation.
  • Drag the center to move the whole image.

Select Rotate to spin it with two fingers without changing size. When it lines up, select End Editing.

slides.title: Export as KMZ
slides.html: Select Export from the rubber sheet Details, or from the Rubber Sheet category in Overlay Manager, to save it as a KMZ file in the atak/tools/rubbersheet folder. A prompt then offers to re-import it as an image overlay.
